label: 广寒宫嫦娥月下回眸：月洞门框景、巨大满月、冷暖对照

subject.description: a young adult Chinese classical goddess, Chang'e, with very long straight black hair falling naturally past her waist, a delicate silver crescent-moon hair ornament clearly visible but restrained in size,
subject.pose: as she stands slightly below center in the moon-gate opening, her body turned three-quarters toward frame right, her head turned back toward the camera in a quiet, restrained backward glance
subject.expression: her cool, lonely, thoughtful expression — no smile, no excessive sadness
subject.wardrobe: layered moon-white, silver-gray, and faint celadon immortal robes between hanfu and fantasy costume — wide flowing sleeves, translucent gauze layers, subtle low-key silver floral, frost, and botanical embroidery, a light, soft, faintly pearlescent texture, with no ornate gold

sections.heading: Composition
sections.body: a huge, dark, ancient, ornate circular wooden gate frame surrounds the frame edges as a natural circular vignette; an extremely large, hazy, softly bright full moon sits at the upper center, partially veiled by night mist and clouds; the figure stands in the lower-center of the gate opening; her crescent-moon hair ornament echoes the full moon in the sky as a small-and-large moon correspondence; the folding fan opens toward her right; the warm palace lantern sits at frame right; osmanthus and plants occupy the left and right foreground.

sections.heading: Fan
sections.body: she holds an opened Chinese folding fan near her right side — gray-silver, light brown-gray, or pale celadon-gray, with clearly visible ribs, the posture natural and elegant.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: the dreamlike Moon Palace at night: distant ancient Chinese palaces, pavilions, eaves, and layered terraces, all veiled in thick blue-green night mist as vague silhouettes; low clouds and mist float over the ground and the distance, creating immortal-realm spatial layering; a single small warm red-orange palace lantern at frame right midground is the only obvious warm light source in the cold frame.

sections.heading: Foreground
sections.body: dense clusters of small osmanthus branches, flowering twigs, and hazy plants grow at the lower left and right of the moon gate and in the foreground — gray-green, gray-pink, and pale brown, densely flowered but soft-focus, never garish; branches naturally intrude into the frame edges to strengthen the foreground-background layering.

camera.position: inside the palace, shooting outward through the gate
camera.perspective: a medium-long distance with gentle subject-background separation, the background never fully blurred away; slight soft focus
camera.framing: a full-body composition inside the circular gate frame

light.key: Soft cyan-blue moonlight dominates, the full moon forming a huge diffused backlight with atmospheric perspective
light.fill: a very soft side-front fill on her face, her skin naturally cool-fair, with the faintest warm orange reflection from the lantern at frame right; no strong rim light, no high contrast

background: the mist-veiled Moon Palace nightscape as described, never reduced to a pure white or empty backdrop
palette_text: muted hazy celadon, gray-blue, moon white, touches of gray pink
atmosphere: a faded Oriental film-dream mood — poetic, quiet, restrained, ethereal, with damp night mist
quality: slightly lowered contrast with gently lifted blacks
the feel of an old cinema lens shooting a dream
negative: a crescent moon in the sky
